description:
Karabeni is listed as a Japanese black tea cultivar. Little is documented about it, including its native spelling.

As with other Japanese black teas, the leaf is withered, rolled, oxidised and dried, usually by small producers.

The class tends to be gentle, with low astringency, so brew it just below the boil and keep the first steep modest. If you meet a lot of it, ask the producer where it was grown and how it was picked.
history: Little is documented about where and when Karabeni was bred, who released it, or where it is grown today.
